loader.line_termination: first CR or LF is replaced by NUL
loader.missing_file: leave list empty and return without error synthesis
loader.allocation_failure: discard current record and continue or leave list empty; no synthesized token

lookup.cleanup: dedicated traversal frees token then node and clears global head

comparison_helper.behavior: lookup token by slot, then compare supplied string against stored token
comparison_helper.comparison_result: true only when Worldgroup _sameas reports equality; exact collation remains host-owned

runtime_policy.duplicate_slots: last physical record wins because nodes are prepended

limitations: The algorithm that creates or authorizes the token values remains outside this loader path.
Exact _sameas collation and case-folding semantics remain Worldgroup-host owned.
